Users.description: Paths of the authentication related pages, relative to the tenant base path. Leading and trailing '/' characters are ignored. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Users/.

LoginPath.description: The path of the login page.

LogoffPath.description: The path used to log off.

ChangePasswordUrl.description: The path of the change password page.

ChangePasswordConfirmationUrl.description: The path of the page displayed after the password is changed.

ExternalLoginsUrl.description: The path of the page used to manage the external logins of the current user.

TwoFactorAuthenticationPath.description: The path of the former two-factor authentication page, which redirects to the Security page.

SecurityPath.description: The path of the page where users manage their two-factor authentication and their passkeys.

Passkeys.description: The options of the passkeys used to sign in, available when the 'Passkeys' feature is enabled.

ServerDomain.description: The domain the passkeys are bound to, also known as the relying party ID. Defaults to the host of the request. Changing it invalidates the passkeys that were already registered.

AuthenticatorTimeout.description: How long the browser waits for the user to use their passkey, as a time span.

ChallengeSize.description: The size, in bytes, of the random challenge signed by the passkey.

UserVerificationRequirement.description: Whether the user must be verified with a biometric or a PIN. A passkey sign-in only counts as multi-factor when it is 'required'.

ResidentKeyRequirement.description: Whether new passkeys must be discoverable, so that users can sign in without typing their username.

AttestationConveyancePreference.description: Whether the authenticator should provide an attestation of its make and model when a passkey is registered.

AuthenticatorAttachment.description: Limits new passkeys to the authenticator of the device ('platform') or to roaming authenticators such as security keys ('cross-platform'). Any authenticator is allowed when not set.

OrchardCore_Users.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_Users' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:Users' instead.
